description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Table' class within the Summernote text editor project. It uses chai and jquery to test various table operations such as creation, deletion, row and column addition/removal, including complex cases with cell spanning and nested structures.

classes.name: base:editing.Table
classes.description: The Table class provides methods to manipulate HTML tables within the Summernote editor, including creating, deleting, adding/removing rows and columns, handling merged cells with colspan and rowspan.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new HTML table with specified rows and columns.

methods.name: deleteTable
methods.description: Deletes the table containing the specified range.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to the table at the specified position relative to the given range.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Deletes a row from the table at the position of the specified range.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table at the position of the specified range, either to the left or right.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Removes a column from the table at the position of the specified range.
